envelope.description: Record the task identity format on the attempt header

body.title: Record the task identity format on the attempt header
body.summary: Add the optional taskIdentityFormat: 'final-task-v2' field to the attempt header interface and its strict schema in src/workflow/code-review/task-review/contracts.ts, export the TaskIdentityFormat type, and extend validateSavedAttribution so the field must be absent on unpinned, pending and failed attempts.
acceptanceChecks: A header with taskIdentityFormat 'final-task-v2' passes the strict schema; any other value is refused.
An unpinned, pending or failed attempt carrying taskIdentityFormat is refused with the existing messages.
Saved attempts without the field validate exactly as before.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/reuse-identity.test.ts: the attempt header schema accepts only the v2 identity format
src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/reuse-identity.test.ts: an identity format on an unaccepted attempt is refused
